mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(profit_amount), 0) FROM tb_investment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ddsy), 0) FROM tb_investment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(investment_amount*invest_count), 0) FROM tb_investment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(profit_interest), 0) FROM tb_investment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(profit_principal), 0) FROM tb_investment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM tb_investment_record WHERE investment_amount > 0 ORDER BY user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_investment_record WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_investment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(investment_amount*invest_count), 0) as totalInvestment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN investment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as pendingInvestment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN investment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedInvestment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN profit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalProfit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN ddsy ELSE 0 END), 0) as pendingInterest FROM tb_investment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ir.project_id) as items, COALESCE(SUM(ir.investment_amount*invest_count), 0) as totalPrincipal, COALESCE(SUM(ir.profit_amount), 0) as totalProfit FROM tb_investment_record ir INNER JOIN tb_project p ON ir.project_id = p.invest_id WHERE ir.user_id = #{userId} AND ir.status = 1 -- 已结束的项目

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ir.project_id) as items, COALESCE(SUM(ir.investment_amount*invest_count), 0) as totalPrincipal, COALESCE(SUM(ir.profit_amount), 0) as totalProfit FROM tb_investment_record ir INNER JOIN tb_project p ON ir.project_id = p.invest_id WHERE ir.user_id = #{userId} AND ir.status = 0
